<thought>To create the complete network, I merged the two subnetworks. The first subnet provides two resistors (2.222 Ω and 4.444 Ω) between nodes A‑N1 and N1‑X1; I assigned them new unique IDs R7 and R8. The second subnet supplies six resistors (45 Ω, 5 Ω, 35 Ω, 15 Ω, 20 Ω, 30 Ω) connecting node B to intermediate nodes N_b1, N_b2, N_b3 and each of those to X1, using IDs R1‑R6 as given. The combined topology therefore contains eight resistors with the following connections.</thought>
<final_answer>{"resistors": {"R1": 45.0, "R2": 5.0, "R3": 35.0, "R4": 15.0, "R5": 20.0, "R6": 30.0, "R7": 2.222, "R8": 4.444}, "connections": [["A","N1","R7"], ["N1","X1","R8"], ["B","N_b1","R1"], ["N_b1","X1","R2"], ["B","N_b2","R3"], ["N_b2","X1","R4"], ["B","N_b3","R5"], ["N_b3","X1","R6"]]}
